✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Vincent goes quiet — and wakes up inside Humu. Vincent never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Humu will never be hungry again while it hums, and Vincent is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Darius.
📓 Codex: Ashford split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler says Ashford burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 5 people, 34 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 7 plants — 5 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Darius of The Red Table with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Darius of The Red Table raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Darius of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 911 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
